items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: So I went out there that Tuesday and I made rehearsal and then I got with Sidney Desvene's orchestra. I played with him for a number of years.

ctx.x: No, they just used orchestration. Well a few arrangements, not too many. Reginald stock arrangements? Just stock, regular stock, yes sir. Reginald stock arrangements. And to tell you I came here and I played with Kit Harris.

And when I was playing with Kit Harris, a fellow by the name of Eugene Ware, he was a trumpet player in the Desvene's orchestra. And he came up there to hear us one night rehearsal and Desvene at that particular time he needed a trombone player. And Mr. Ware must have went and told Desvene that if you want a good trombone player you can get him one. So after I lost my wife, I waited a year and I happened to go by the Bulls, you know where that is. Bulls uptown. And this fellow Ware saw me and he called me. And…

items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Well, Louis Nelson used to get full, you know, and I'd high him and fire him and high him and fire him.

ctx.x: Louis Nelson wasn't in that group.

No, no, no. That was a trombone player, Moran, right there. Yeah. Well, Louis Nelson used to get full, you know, and I'd high him and fire him and high him and fire him. He stopped drinking though. No, he did, huh? He was in good shape. Well, that's the way I carried my band all the time in different uniforms at that time. Oh, yeah, that's nice. Yeah. And the singer had on the dark. That's right.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: And I met Sidney Desvene and I started playing with him.

ctx.x: What was your first band you played with?

Joseph Garber was out in the country, out in the Polandville. Then I came to New Orleans. My first wife, she died. And that's when I met Kit Harris. Kit Harris, yes. And I played with him. And one night I was at the Bulls. And I met Sidney Desvene and I started playing with him.
What kind of band did Kit Harris have?
